newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FIC rights issue to raise T$625 mln.
newsitem.headline: FIC rights issue to raise T$625 mln.

text.p: Taiwan's First International Computer said on Friday it would raise T$625 million through a rights issue of 25 million new shares with an underwriting price of T$25 per share.
"We have sent the application to the Securities and Exchange Commission and are awaiting approval," First International spokeswoman Wu Li-yin said by telephone.
Shareholders would be allowed to buy 34.78 shares for every 1,000 shares owned, she added.
Of the T$625 million raised, the company plans to use T$200 million to expand operation of its notebook computer production line in Taiwan's northern Linkou county.
"The rest of the money will be reserved as extra working capital," Wu said.
